empty.title: What would you like to know about the schedule?
empty.body: Ask about a patient, a doctor, a date or a status. I remember the conversation, so you can keep narrowing it down.

composer.label: Message Samvad Assistant
composer.placeholder: Ask about appointments, e.g. “Who needs review today?”
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

slots.hours: Clinic hours 9 AM – 1 PM and 2 PM – 5 PM, in 30-minute slots.

reply.greeting: Hello! I can look up today's schedule, a patient's next visit, a doctor's free slots or anything that needs your review.
reply.thanks: Happy to help. Anything else about the schedule?
reply.help: I answer from the appointment schedule. Ask about a patient, a doctor or department, a date (“tomorrow”, “next week”, “5 Dec”) or a status (“needs review”, “follow-up”), and combine them freely. Follow-ups like “and tomorrow?” or “only those needing review” keep the context.
reply.unknown: I couldn't match that to the schedule. Try a patient or doctor's name, a date like “tomorrow”, or a status like “needs review”.
reply.whichPatient: Which patient do you mean? Tell me their name or patient ID (like SMV-1001).
reply.listNone: No appointments match that. Try a wider date range or fewer filters.
reply.count_zero: There are no appointments that match.
reply.lastNone: There's no past appointment that matches.
reply.details: Here is the appointment: {{patient}} with {{doctor}}, {{date}} at {{time}}.
reply.patientUnknown: I couldn't find that patient. Try their full name or patient ID (like SMV-1001).
reply.summaryNone: Nothing is scheduled for that period.
reply.slots: Here are the free slots for {{date}}.
reply.slotsNone: No free slots for {{date}} within clinic hours.
reply.doctors_zero: No doctors have appointments in that period.
reply.doctors_one: {{count}} doctor has appointments in that period.
reply.doctors_other: {{count}} doctors have appointments in that period.
